6 Nov
First Friday General

5:00 PM| Historic Downtown Bryan, 100 N. Main St., Bryan, TX 77803

Main Street in Historic Downtown Bryan will close and transform into one big stage for live entertainment, art demos, vendor booths, family-friendly activities and much more. Admission is free.

More information about First Friday

Parking is available in the Roy Kelly Parking Garage for free and there is also a free shuttle service to/from Texas A&M’s Memorial Student Center.

9 Nov
Quarterly Cemetery Cleanup Parks and Recreation

8:00 AM| Bryan City Cemeteries

The quarterly cleanup of Bryan City Cemetery and Oakwood Cemetery is scheduled for Nov. 9-13.

During these cleanups, staff will remove non-compliant items such as loose objects (e.g., glass, ceramics, statues, decorations) and faded or tattered flowers, whether live or artificial, in accordance with cemetery ordinances as listed in Sec. 22-5).

Once removed, we request that these items not be repositioned, as the cemetery sexton reserves the right to remove any items that violate the ordinance.

20 Nov
Maroon & White Night Downtown

6:00 PM| Historic Downtown Bryan, 100 N. Main St., Bryan, TX 77803

Join us for an evening in Historic Downtown Bryan tailored for Texas A&M University and System employees and their loved ones every third Friday evening.

More Maroon & White Night Information

Enjoy an evening filled with live entertainment, delicious local cuisine, and unique bars and shops. This is the perfect opportunity to meet up with colleagues, make new friends, and enjoy a fun and relaxing night out. Whether you’re looking to unwind after a long week or explore what Downtown Bryan has to offer, this event is for you!

There will be a variety of specials and discounts just for showing your Texas A&M employee ID or business card.
